summary: The analysis of these candidates reveals a strong prevalence of dual roles (confounder and effect_modifier), particularly among neurological burden markers (features 337, 338, 340, 341). Several candidates serve purely as effect modifiers (339, 342, 344) due to high R-learner/Causal Forest support despite negligible treatment prediction. Systemic health factors (345, 346) and prior medications (343) show mixed evidence, with 345 showing strong dual-role stability and 346 appearing as a weak confounder.
